prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create 6 separate square PNG icons that form ONE consistent set for a figure in a scientific paper. Make one image_gen call per icon.
Style for every icon: clean flat vector illustration, uniform thin dark-grey outlines, soft pastel fills with the accent colour as the main hue, at most one lighter tint for highlights, no gradients, no drop shadows, no texture.
Pure white (#FFFFFF) background, square 1024x1024 canvas, the subject centred with about 12% empty margin on every side, readable as a silhouette at 8 mm wide. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI chrome, borders or frames anywhere in the image.
Image 1 (executor.png) is a STYLE REFERENCE from the same figure set, not an edit target: match its character design, outline weight, fill treatment and margin.
Icons:
(1) model.png: the same robot character from the reference image, standing still inside a translucent pale ice block, eyes calm, a small snowflake on its chest, meaning a frozen model whose weights never change, accent colour #8F98A4.
(2) subagent.png: the same robot character from the reference image, smaller, waving and holding a small task card, meaning a newly spawned helper agent, accent colour #C27896.
(3) context.png: a short stack of three paper notes sliding into a rounded speech bubble, meaning text assembled into a model's context, accent colour #5A8BCB.
(4) plugin.png: a plug-in puzzle piece clipped onto a curved loop arrow, meaning a hook that intercepts every tool call, accent colour #8C6CC8.
(5) tools.png: a small terminal window with a wrench resting across its corner, meaning tools and scripts the model can call, accent colour #5E9E62.
(6) orchestration.png: two small rounded nodes linked by a forked arrow branching from one parent node, meaning work delegated to new agents, accent colour #C27896.
Copy each final image into the current directory with exactly those file names, overwrite nothing else, do not edit the images afterwards, then list the directory.
